items.title: Build clearer, more expressive Real-Time Dashboards with new design and KPI capabilities (Generally Available)
items.text: Sections: Give your dashboard a clear structure with Design Tiles; Show related metrics together with multi-KPI; Match each KPI to the metric and the available space; Build one coherent operational story; Get started; Create dashboards that are easier to act on. The new, generally available authoring capabilities in Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Dashboards help authors create dashboards that are easier to scan and act on. Design Tiles add structure and context, multi-KPI groups related measures from one query, and KPI styling makes status, scale, and targets easier to interpret. Together, these capabilities give viewers a clear path from context to metrics to investigation while reducing repetitive authoring work. Figure: Camp Nou Stadium Operations Center dashboard using Design Tiles, Multi-KPI, and styled KPIs. A dashboard can contain accurate visuals and still make viewers work too hard to find what matters. As service health, deployment status, business metrics, and diagnostic details…
